claim: The demo converts a bundled DOCX and writes Markdown plus a fidelity report.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; bundled sample; assert Markdown and report files plus review findings

claim: Document conversion runs locally and sends no document data over the network.
sandbox: fresh browser context on /demo; intercept requests and assert only same-origin site assets load

claim: Reports list tables, comments, revisions, embedded objects, footnotes, styles, and image outcomes with source locations.
sandbox: bundled complex DOCX fixture; assert every construct category and source location in JSON report

claim: Literal Word text stays literal in Markdown; ordered, bullet, and nested lists are preserved or source-located for review.
sandbox: fresh DOCX fixtures with Markdown-looking text, decimal and nested numbering.xml definitions, and an unknown list; assert literal output, preserved list syntax, and a source-located loss finding

claim: One command converts every DOCX in a directory.
sandbox: fresh directory with two DOCX fixtures whose names normalize to the same safe stem; assert two distinct Markdown files and reports

claim: CI policy gates stop a conversion at selected risk levels without a network connection.
sandbox: bundled complex DOCX with blocked findings; assert --fail-on exits 3 while HTTP proxies are unreachable

claim: The CLI limits ZIP and XML parts, rejects unsafe archive paths, and never extracts embedded objects or macros.
sandbox: malicious path, embedded-object/macro, 32 MiB plus one byte, and 10,001-entry DOCX fixtures; assert safe failure and no binary extraction

claim: Demo sample data is not saved; Reset demo and Start for real clear only demo state.
sandbox: fresh browser demo context; seed demo: and real: keys, activate Reset demo and Start for real, and assert only demo: keys are removed

claim: Each conversion writes a separate human review checklist.
sandbox: CLI demo from a fresh temporary directory; assert the generated .fidelity.md file contains a review checklist and finding checkboxes

claim: The release build produces one Rust CLI binary.
sandbox: locked release build; assert target/release/docx-fidelity exists and reports its version

claim: Stable Rust 1.88 or newer builds the locked package.
where: README install and verification instructions, Cargo.toml
sandbox: run cargo +1.88.0 test --locked --lib and assert the locked library test suite passes

claim: The CLI leaves source DOCX files unchanged and offers no OCR, document editing, or PDF conversion command.
sandbox: convert a copied bundled DOCX, byte-compare the source before and after, and assert CLI help has no OCR, edit, or PDF command
